summary: Completed comprehensive backend + frontend testing of the new Equipment Master & Maintenance Management module and light regression on Glass Breakage Register. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass covering Equipment Types CRUD (create, duplicate 409, update with denormalization to children, seed-defaults idempotent, delete blocked when children exist, delete empty), Equipment CRUD (auto-computed next_maintenance_due / next_replacement_due from last date + frequency, invalid type 400, list filter+search, update), vendor associations (server-side vendor_name hydration, preferred flag, lead_time, price, part code, contact, AMC all persisted), and log-maintenance / log-replacement (last date updated, next due recomputed, log entry appended with by=user name). Frontend: UI verified end-to-end via Playwright — seed-defaults renders 9 type cards (Filters, Pumps etc.), custom type create/delete, Add Equipment dialog with type select, maintfreq=30, last-maint date, add-vendor row with preferred checkbox, equipment row appears in eq-table with type badge Filters, preferred-star + vendor name, Next Maintenance chip = 2026-02-14 (=2026-01-15 + 30d, matches auto-compute), then Log Maintenance with 2026-01-20 → chip moves to 2026-02-19 (+30d). All cleanup completed (test equipment deleted, custom type deleted). Glass Breakage regression: /glass-breakage-register loads with glass-breakage-page testid and Record Breakage dialog opens.

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' on eq-log-dialog (no DialogDescription). Minor a11y polish — non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: equipment_master.py is clean and compact (~268 lines). Uses async/motor properly, excludes _id, all validations via Pydantic, tenant-scoped queries, and auto-compute logic is centralized in _compute_dues.
Frontend EquipmentMaster.js (~481 lines) is within the 700-line limit; well-structured; has data-testids on all critical elements.
Minor: DialogContent missing DialogDescription on eq-log-dialog & type-form-dialog triggers a11y console warning. Consider adding <DialogDescription> for a11y compliance.
Minor: DELETE equipment button in eq-table row does not have a dedicated data-testid (uses generic Trash2 button). Could add eq-delete-{name} testid for future test scripts.
Minor: Vendor row does not have a delete testid on the Remove button; could add for parity.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Equipment Master + Glass Breakage regression checks passed)
